title: Daily Workout · October 26
note: Recovery day after flu and COVID vaccines yesterday. Mild headache improving, sore arms. Optional easy walk only; skip jogging, steep inclines, strength and core today. Stop if headache worsens or you feel unwell.

items.name: Gentle warm-up walk
items.instructions: Start at an easy, comfortable pace. Skip workout if feeling unwell.

items.name: Comfortable treadmill walk
items.instructions: Keep effort easy enough for normal conversation. No jogging.

items.name: Easy steady walk
items.instructions: Stay comfortable; reduce speed or incline if headache increases.

items.name: Gentle cool-down
items.instructions: Slow down gradually. Stop if symptoms worsen.
